links.name: Missing or inconsistent originator and beneficiary information
links.ctx: Payment messages incomplete, inconsistent or use placeholder data.

links.name: Missing, incomplete or placeholder originator and beneficiary information
links.ctx: Incoming or outgoing payment messages carry placeholder, truncated or missing originator and beneficiary data, hindering alignment checks and tracing along the chain.

links.name: Missing or poor-quality payment message information
links.ctx: Messages lack originator or beneficiary data or use unclear references.

links.name: Payments with missing, truncated or inconsistent ordering or beneficiary information
links.ctx: Messages omit key details or show inconsistent data.

links.name: Originator or beneficiary fields missing, generic or truncated
links.ctx: Payments carry placeholders such as 'customer' or incomplete addresses for parties in higher-risk jurisdictions.

links.name: Poor or missing sender and recipient information in transfers
links.ctx: Payment messages lack complete originator or beneficiary details.
links.fp: Systems limitations may cause incomplete data.
